NASA Announces Technical Demonstrations and Presentations at SC26

November 15, 2026

Shares

NASA will highlight its work in high performance computing at SC26, Booth #4038

Credit: NASA

Nov. 15, 2026 — Join NASA at SC26 for presentations exploring the computing technologies supporting its research and missions.

From spaceflight computing and water availability modeling to programming tools and HPC facility management, NASA experts will discuss their work at Booth #4038 in the Exhibit Hall. The full Nov. 17–19 Tech Demo schedule is below.

SC26 is the largest international HPC conference, attracting more than 18,000 attendees from around the world who come to see the latest innovations in HPC and related fields.

Event Details

WHPC (Women in HPC) is hosting a full-day workshop, our Rising Stars early-career program, and a networking reception at SC26 this November in Chicago, part of our mission to expand access, foster belonging, and increase participation in the global HPC workforce.

Event Details

Enterprise AI World 2026 explores how organizations are designing AI-enabled environments that support collaboration, learning, and responsible use in real operational settings. From informal “vibe coding” and rapid prototyping to agents that support software builds, content pipelines, analytics, and even marketing campaigns, AI is reshaping how work gets done across industries.

Knowledge professionals, architects, and technologists play a central role in this shift. Their work connects human expertise, institutional context, and intelligent systems, ensuring that AI is understandable, governable, and aligned with organizational goals.

This 3-day conference brings together practitioners who are aligning AI capabilities with organizational knowledge, culture, and business needs. Attendees will gain practical insight into how AI is actually being used, managed, and adapted inside organizations.
